notes: This drawing is a preliminary subdivision concept. It is not a plat, not a boundary survey, and not for recording.
Lot lines are proposed to meet Sec. 27-4202 RSF-95: minimum net lot area 9500 sq ft, minimum lot width 75 ft, minimum frontage 50 ft, maximum density 4.58 du/ac.
The remainder parcel is not a buildable lot. Subdividing it requires a public street (Sec. 24-128) and a major subdivision preliminary plan (Subtitle 24).
